description: Newcastle's DOCUMENT SHAPE rules - the city-owned half of tests/check_doc_shape.py. check_doc_currency.py pins the NUMBERS a living document states; this pins the SHAPE: the board stays a board, the brief stays short and stamped with the family it was written for, the record grows in order and on a template, the position pages carry a source for every number, and a frozen document says so at the top. Every rule here was breached at least once in August 2026 (DECISIONS.md 9.132).

archives.note: Every .md and .html under docs/archived carries a frozen/archive banner in its first lines; JSON evidence files are not prose and are skipped.
